table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Item.ICode,   
	Item.CustomICode,   
	Item.Name,   
	Item.ICCode,   
	Item.ICatCode,   
	Item.Packcode,
	Item.ManfCode,   
	Item.SalePrice,   
	Item.PurPrice,   
	Item.RetailPrice,   
	Item.AvgPrice,   
	Item.SaleDiscPerc,   
	Item.PurDiscPerc,   
	Item.SalesTax,   
	Item.ReorderQty,   
	Item.OptimumQty,   
	Item.PackUnits,   
	Item.Active,   
	Item.Prescribed,   
	Item.Refrigrated,   
	Item.Printable,   
	Item.Location1,   
	Item.Remarks1,   
	Item.Location,   
	Item.Remarks,   
	Item.Gcode,   
	Item.saleprice2,
	Item.saleprice3,
	Item.RecentPurPrice,
	Item.GReorderQty,
	Item.GOptimumQty ,
	Item.AntiNorCotix,
	Item.Restricted,
	item.PackSalesTax,
	item.GSTPerc1,
	item.GSTPerc2,
	item.packingdesc,
	item.saleqty,
	item.bonusqty,
	Item.PrintExpiry,
	Item.UserCode,
	Item.LastUpdate,
	Item.locksaleprice,
	Item.lockdiscperc,
	Item.flatdisc,
	stock=(select isnull(sum(currqty),0) from godowndetail where godowndetail.icode=item.icode),
	item.salediscperc2,
	item.salediscperc3,
	item.salediscperc4,
	item.isizecode,
	item.istylecode,
	item.icolourcode,
	item.isleevecode,
	item.iyarncode,
	item.ifabriccode,
	item.ibrandcode,
	item.saleprice4,
	item.saleprice5,
	item.salediscperc5,
	item.minqty,
	item.IPartCode,
	item.OldPartCode,
	item.ItemYear,
	item.RemarksForPurchase,
	item.SizeDescription,
	item.ModelDescription,
	item.TypeDescription,
	item.GenericCode,
	item.TransitStock,
	item.PackingFactor,
	item.itemtypecode,
	item.DiscountedSalePrice,
	item.DiscountedPurPrice,
	item.SalePriceChangeMargin,
	item.generatepo,
	item.qtyused,
	item.measureunitcode,
	masterpartno = 
		CASE WHEN itempart.masteripartcode IS NULL THEN
			(SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPart IP 
			WHERE IP.IPartCode = itempart.ipartcode)
		ELSE
			(SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPart IP 
			WHERE IP.IPartCode = itempart.masteripartcode)
		END,
	Item.bonuspolicycode,
	DiscountPolicyCode
FROM Item, ItemPart
WHERE 
	Item.IPartCode = ItemPart.IPartCode AND
	CASE :as_type WHEN 'M' THEN Item.ManfCode
	WHEN 'C' THEN Item.ICatCode
	WHEN 'L' THEN Item.ICCode
	WHEN 'P' THEN Item.PackCode
	ELSE Item.ICode END in (:ai_code) AND
	item.Active=1
ORDER BY Item.Name
